plugins.calendarPermission: Allow Nomadic Paws Events to show upcoming events and keep shared plans on an iCloud or Google calendar connected to this device.
plugins.remindersPermission: Allow Nomadic Paws Events to coordinate event-planning reminders you choose.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Allow Nomadic Paws Events to find a nearby Stripe card reader while the register is open.
plugins.bluetoothPeripheralPermission: Allow Nomadic Paws Events to connect to the Stripe card reader.
plugins.bluetoothAlwaysUsagePermission: Allow Nomadic Paws Events to connect to the Stripe card reader during an event sale.
plugins.localNetworkUsagePermission: Allow Nomadic Paws Events to communicate with the Stripe card reader on the event network.
